items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: It's like Sybeth used to play trampons.

ctx.x: I say didn't really switch. Because I always wanted to play banjo. Well, my daddy didn't have a banjo. He had every instrument in the house for the banjo. It's like Sybeth used to play trampons. Slide trampons used to play that too. And, uh, nah, I tried every instrument in the house. But I still wanted banjo. And I went to wait for a father. His name was Farber. Went to wait at a girl.

Seven dollars a week and I kept worrying him I wanted a banjo, I wanted a banjo. So he said, well, when Mr. Temple come, I'm going to see if he had one. Mr. Temple was from Basin Lewis. He had a banjo he wanted. He was selling, you know. And at that time that banjo was fifty dollars. So Mr. Temple, he said, bring him a banjo.
